description: Lists the Environment Agency level gauges on a named river in England (for example River Thames or River Severn) with station ids, towns and coordinates. Useful for boaters planning a trip or anyone following a river downstream. Source: Environment Agency real-time flood-monitoring API. The upstream name match is exact, so if nothing matches the tool retries once as "River <Name>" in title case (e.g. "thames" becomes "River Thames") and reports the name it used; other spellings are not guessed, and the list is not in upstream-to-downstream order. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, max stations returned, 1-100, default 25

river_name.description: string, required, river name as the Environment Agency writes it, e.g. River Thames; "thames" or "river thames" is retried as "River Thames"

name: river_stations_on_river
